p.i: Longas malum ante quā inualescat per moras. Tu, Crispe, qui Græcam fidē atq; linguā amas, Non es Magister Noster equidem: sed tamen Quoniam Gnatho Sueui illius Thrasonis es, Eiq; linguam vendis, haud quaquam memor Quod olim Erasti assensus es sententiæ, Te moneo, vtite corrigas, loco vltimo. Ægrè nec id feras, quod aio; loco vltimo, Maximus enim in Processione es vltimus. Holdere, dixi hæc, vt vides, sine hyperbole, Neç vlla adhibui verba sesquipedalia, Nec sœuidicta, (vt scurra, stellio, hypocrita) Certissima argumenta a causa pessimæ, Tibi pessimæ causæ patrono pessimo Emblematum est vti quibus visum loco. Sermone enim gaudet modesto & simplici Bonitate causæ freta veritas sua.

main_text.p: Scriptum ex arce Altenstein Non. Iun. An. 85.

page.notes: Doubtful: "vtite" in line 7 may be printed as "vt ite" (narrow space). "Holdere" in line 10 is as printed, probably a proper name. The faint show-through text lower on the page (mirrored from the other side) is left out. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
